description: Unit tests for the GitCL class in the webkitpy.common.net.git_cl module, testing methods like run, get_issue_number, wait_for_try_jobs, and latest_try_jobs.

classes.name: GitCLTest
classes.description: Test suite for the GitCL class, covering various methods and behaviors.

methods.name: test_run
methods.description: Tests the run method of GitCL for correct output and command execution.

methods.name: test_run_with_auth
methods.description: Tests run method with authentication token parameter.

methods.name: test_some_commands_not_run_with_auth
methods.description: Ensures certain commands are not run with auth parameters.

methods.name: test_get_issue_number
methods.description: Verifies extraction of issue number from output.

methods.name: test_get_issue_number_none
methods.description: Checks behavior when no issue number is present.

methods.name: test_all_jobs_finished_empty
methods.description: Tests static method with empty job list.

methods.name: test_wait_for_try_jobs_time_out

methods.name: test_wait_for_try_jobs_done
methods.description: Tests behavior when try jobs complete successfully.

methods.name: test_all_jobs_finished_with_started_jobs

methods.name: test_all_jobs_finished_only_completed_jobs

methods.name: test_has_failing_try_results_empty

methods.name: test_has_failing_try_results_only_success_and_started
